maya: Heads up — noticed a jump in "unassigned" HubSpot leads this morning around 08:22 UTC. ~38 leads bounced to unassigned.

leo: Any correlation with enrichment or our HS webhook?

maya: Looks like hs-enrich-stream occasionally returns after 11-14s. Our HubSpot webhook timeout is 8s, so HS marks the webhook as failed and route falls back to no owner.

sophie: Oof. Two quick options: raise the webhook timeout to 15s (fast), or make routing-service ack immediately and let enrich complete asynchronously (safer).

nate: I'm leaning async ack. If routing-service returns 202 + temp-owner token, we can avoid final unassigned state while enrich completes. Also add a small TTL on temp-owner so no permanent incorrect ownership.

ops-bot: deploybot: routing-service v1.8.9 deployed to staging -> id: b7c9e1 (canary).

leo: Can we implement a "claim-pending" state in HS via a webhook response header? If HS receives X-Claim-Status: pending it could hold off finalizing owner. Not sure HS supports custom headers reliably.

maya: If headers are flaky, we can update the webhook payload: {state: "pending", temp_owner: "sdr_pool"} and change the HS workflow to interpret that.

sophie: For temporary fix, I'll raise timeout to 12s in HubSpot webhook config so fewer false failures. But we should treat this as mitigation only.

nate: I'll prototype routing change: return 202 + temp_owner, then kick async enrichment and final claim update. Config knobs: temp_owner.ttl=30s, retry.count=3, backoff=700ms.

leo: Can we set an SLA: 95% of leads should have final owner assigned within 25s, and 99% within 60s? That matches our customer promise for speedy routing.

maya: Sounds reasonable. I'll add a Grafana panel: hs.assign_status (pending|assigned|unassigned) and alert if unassigned_rate > 1% for 1m.

sophie: I'll also open a support ticket with HubSpot to confirm webhook retry semantics and whether custom payload fields are safe.

nate: PR incoming for async-ack pattern. Will include feature flag: routing.async_ack=true. Plan to run canary in staging, run smoke tests hitting HS sandbox, then promote.

maya: Action list: sophie = raise HS timeout to 12s + HubSpot ticket; nate = PR + canary + smoke; leo = define SLA numbers and add dashboard queries; maya = alert + sandbox runbook. Review after smoke window tomorrow 07:00-08:00 PDT. :thumbsup:

leo: Thanks all. Please drop PR link and canary metrics in this thread when available.

maya: Will post metrics. Closing for now — follow-ups in thread. :sparkles:
